visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of a young boy with short black hair lying on a yellow and white patterned pillow featuring a cartoon window. The lighting is soft and warm, typical of a home bedroom environment at night. (2) The boy reaches up with his right hand to touch his hair while looking directly at the person filming. His hands are small and his movements are slow and deliberate. He appears to be responding to an off-screen person with a playful glint in his eyes. A few green plastic leaves from a toy plant are visible in the lower-left corner. (3) The camera pans down slightly to reveal several plastic dinosaur toys resting on the bed covers next to the boy. There is a dark-colored T-Rex and a smaller green dinosaur. The boy’s hand enters the frame to adjust one of the toy dinosaurs, showing his engagement with the objects. (4) The boy continues to lie on his side, interacting with the T-Rex toy by bringing it close to his face and making it move as if it were biting. He maintains a playful and content expression. In the background, a woman's face becomes partially visible resting on the bed next to him, suggesting a shared family moment.
